headline: Benchmarks probe AlphaFold model accuracy across peptides, RNA, and antibody complexes
label: Structural Model Interface Evaluation
summary: Recent preprints score AlphaFold2, OpenFold3, and AlphaFold3 models with interface-level criteria and flag structural fragility.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational assessment of predicted structural models at the level of interfaces, binding relevance, and local reliability. A systematic benchmark of AlphaFold2 and OpenFold3 on 271 protein-peptide complexes, scored with CAPRI criteria, finds AF2 more accurate and shows evidence of memorization. Engineering of AlphaFold3 MSA and template inputs targets monomer, multimer, and protein-ligand predictions, reported with TM-score and DockQ. CASP16 RNA analysis links multimer interface errors to monomer accuracy and model selection. SNAC-DB provides antibody and VHH-antigen complexes with 31-37% more structural diversity than SAbDab, with benchmarks of seven predictors. AlphaUnfold couples AlphaFold3 with short high-pressure MD to flag low-pLDDT regions as fragile. Binding free energy methods are compared on shared Amber force fields, and Martini Mapper automates Martini 3 coarse-grained model construction from SMILES.
